gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Thinkware U3000 PRO's Smart Parking switches the camera to impact-only recording when the cabin gets too hot, and that impact-only mode (Energy Saving) has no stated before-impact footage. Thinkware's own store page also gives no current-draw figure for radar mode, only '10% lower than the U3000', so the 'low-power radar' pick cannot be compared in mA with VIOFO's <40 mA, which is for a mode that keeps no footage from before the hit.
standout_why: Compared against milewitness.com (cited in chat 1), which I opened on 2026-11-21. It already makes most of this angle's point. It gives 10 s before and 10 s after for Thinkware Motion & Impact, a 7 s before / 13 s after radar example, and 10 s before / 30 s after for the Vantrue N4 Pro S. It reports VIOFO's <40 mA at 12.6 V and says that low-power mode has no pre-event footage, and it notes that the battery-pack hours are quoted per channel (iVolt Mini 'up to 20 hours' for one channel; BP100 32 h at 3 W against 14 h 39 min for a three-channel A329S). What I did not see on Mile Witness is the Smart Parking heat fallback to impact-only, or any absolute mA figure for Thinkware radar mode. Not compared: vortexradar.com (cited) returned HTTP 403 and caranddriver.com (cited) cannot be fetched, so I don't know if either covers this. dashcamtalk.com/thinkware-u3000-pro (not in ChatGPT's results) gives no figures.
decides: Confirms that ChatGPT picked the U3000 PRO for its pre-impact radar clip (20 s clip, 10 s before / 10 s after in Motion & Impact, per Thinkware). It adds a caveat for hot climates: Thinkware's Smart Parking drops to impact-only when the cabin is too hot, and Thinkware states no before-impact footage for that mode. In those hours it behaves like an impact-only camera, which ChatGPT's own table says 'usually' misses the car that drives off. It also means the page cannot rank on 'low power' as a figure: the only maker-stated parked current (VIOFO <40 mA at 12.6 V) is for a mode with no before-impact footage, and Thinkware gives no mA for radar. The page should rank on before-impact seconds per mode, with power shown as battery-pack hours at the channel count actually used. Our Vantrue N4 Pro S has a sourced 10 s before / 30 s after motion clip (Mile Witness), so it can sit on the same terms. N5S and Botslab G980H parking figures are still unsourced.
